gloss: sea mail; surface mail; ship transport

definitions.gloss: sea mail; surface mail; shipping by sea
definitions.explanation: Mail, packages, or cargo sent by ship rather than by air. Slower but cheaper than airmail, commonly used for heavy or bulky items.

examples.japanese: {船便|ふなびん}で{送|おく}ると{安|やす}い。
examples.english: It's cheaper to send by sea mail.

examples.japanese: {船便|ふなびん}だと{届|とど}くまで２{ヶ月|かげつ}かかる。
examples.english: By sea mail, it takes two months to arrive.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{荷物|にもつ}は{船便|ふなびん}で{送|おく}り、{身|み}の{回|まわ}りの{物|もの}だけ{航空便|こうくうびん}にした。
examples.english: I sent the moving boxes by sea and only shipped personal essentials by air.

notes:
Composed of {船|ふな} (ship, combining form) + {便|びん} (mail, service). Note that {船|ふね} changes to {船|ふな} in compounds. This is a practical word for anyone living abroad or sending international packages.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {船便|ふなびん}で{送|おく}る: to send by sea mail
- {船便|ふなびん}で{届|とど}く: to arrive by sea mail
- {船便|ふなびん}の{料金|りょうきん}: sea mail rates

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {航空便|こうくうびん}: airmail — faster but more expensive
- SAL{便|びん}: economy airmail — intermediate speed and cost
- {小包|こづつみ}: parcel, package — refers to the item, not the shipping method
